state.review: Adversarial review of selected causal cross-owner choreography. A reactor or command dispatch is not proof of target commitment. Treat missing proof as a gap.

flows.logicalPrerequisiteRule: selected applicable typed variant/set; see required proof contract
flows.proofGate: Exact terminal parent decision or receiver-fenced cancellation proof; settle only the matching operation/generation, never release because of time/missing read. A canceled parent fences local completion; record terminal source-use settlement even when acquire has not yet arrived, so delayed acquisition cannot recreate authority. Derive Disposition from the proven terminal source: parent_closed installs its generation closure fence, canceled clears only this use after parent fence, irreversible_decision releases the pinned source after historical decision. Never clear a use into an unrestricted writable child after parent closure.

requiredTypedStageProofSets.requiredVerification: Resolve actual saved owner/source fact and full metadata/cut, verify typed payload/immutable content and exact admission/root/target/generation/actor/intent binding. Pointer, checkpoint and stage order alone are not authority.

flows.requiredLogicalPrerequisiteProofs: Every applicable logical prerequisite is independently verified as an actual typed saved fact (or actual technical proof where explicitly technical); a terminal proof may establish an earlier stage only through a verified native chain that includes that required typed stage. Stage order/checkpoint alone never substitutes.
flows.pinnedSourceRequirements: Every exact source owner/event/content revision and complete immutable manifest required by intendedProofGate remains mandatory; no absent optional source is fabricated.

verification.admission: AdmissionReference is a locator only. Resolve and independently verify actual typed admitted fact, exact owner/tenant/program, saved metadata and physical/hydrated cut, original root/episode/actor/intent and immutable content.
verification.stageAndTerminal: Materialize each required typed stage/terminal proof from actual committed facts and full required immutable selections; prove complete grant/fence/provisional/child sets, not counts/checkpoints. Guard sets are not weakened by carrier choice.
verification.earlyReplay: If native receipt binding does not cover a supplied/interpreted command term, bind that term through the required actual typed proof/body before early replay. Exact receipt cannot bypass proof manifest or source tuple guards.
verification.resultAndRecovery: Current public authorization precedes replay. Original result/receipt and unknown-append recovery stay exact; requested cancellation propagates. Unavailable proof/content remains transient; corruption/changed intent is permanent; no inferred absence/release.
verification.implementationStatus: Installed pointer/handler/process presence is not proof of conformance. Field/wire migration and required behavioral tests remain separately verifiable implementation work.

flows.recoveryContract: Exact replay returns original result; proven superseded operation is terminal no-op; unavailable dependency/unknown append is transient; changed intent or invalid proof is permanent conflict/quarantine.

item_0.instructions: Does cross-owner flow T066 preserve the source and target owners' decision boundaries and require sufficient proof before target effects?

criteria.flow_is_logical: The source admits or completes its own fact; the target decides its own invariant from verified exact typed proofs, with ordered idempotent recovery.
criteria.flow_boundary_or_order_defect: The flow bypasses an owner decision, has an unjustified edge/order, or lets dispatch/pointer/checkpoint/count stand in for target authority.
criteria.proof_or_recovery_gap: The flow lacks a required identity, source, intermediate/terminal proof, cancellation fence, retry, restart, or lost-ack rule.
